items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer is still appropriate for use when:
items.translation: PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer 在以下情况仍然适用：

items.source: The default implementation delegates to resolvePlaceholder (placeholder, props) before/after the system properties check.
items.translation: 默认实现会在系统属性检查之前/之后委托给 `resolvePlaceholder(placeholder, props)`。

items.source:
The default is "fallback": If not being able to resolve a placeholder
with the specified properties, a system property will be tried.
"override" will check for a system property first, before trying the
specified properties. "never" will not check system properties at all.
items.translation: 默认值为 "fallback"：如果无法使用指定的属性解析占位符，将尝试系统属性。"override" 会先检查系统属性，然后再尝试指定的属性。"never" 则完全不检查系统属性。

items.source:
Default is "true". Switch this setting off to never resolve placeholders
against system environment variables. Note that it is generally recommended
to pass external values in as JVM system properties: This can easily be
achieved in a startup script, even for existing environment variables.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。关闭此设置可防止将占位符解析为系统环境变量。请注意，通常建议通过 JVM 系统属性传递外部值：这可以在启动脚本中轻松实现，即使对于现有的环境变量也是如此。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this for custom resolution strategies,
including customized points for the system properties check.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以使用自定义解析策略，包括为系统属性检查定制点。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this for customized placeholder-to-key mappings
or custom resolution strategies, possibly just using the given properties
as fallback.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义的占位符到键的映射或自定义解析策略，可能仅将给定的属性用作回退。

items.source:
Note that system properties will still be checked before respectively
after this method is invoked, according to the system properties mode.
items.translation: 请注意，无论此方法是在系统属性模式下的调用之前还是之后执行，都会根据系统属性模式检查系统属性。

items.source: Never check system properties.
items.translation: 切勿检查系统属性。

items.source:
Visit each bean definition in the given bean factory and attempt to replace ${...} property
placeholders with values from the given properties.
items.translation: 遍历给定 Bean 工厂中的每个 Bean 定义，并尝试使用给定属性中的值替换 ${...} 属性占位符。

items.source:
Resolve the given key as JVM system property, and optionally also as
system environment variable if no matching system property has been found.
items.translation: 将给定的键解析为 JVM 系统属性，如果未找到匹配的系统属性，则可选地将其解析为系统环境变量。

items.source:
Set the system property mode by the name of the corresponding constant,
for example, "SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_OVERRIDE".
items.translation: 通过对应常量的名称设置系统属性模式，例如"SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_OVERRIDE"。

items.source:
Check system properties if not resolvable in the specified properties.
This is the default.
items.translation: 如果无法在指定的属性中解析，则检查系统属性。这是默认行为。

items.source:
Check system properties first, before trying the specified properties.
This allows system properties to override any other property source.
items.translation:
首先检查系统属性，然后再尝试指定的属性。
这允许系统属性覆盖任何其他属性源。

items.source: existing configuration makes use of the "systemPropertiesMode" and/or "systemPropertiesModeName" properties. Users are encouraged to move away from using these settings, and rather configure property source search order through the container's Environment; however, exact preservation of functionality may be maintained by continuing to use PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer.
items.translation: 现有配置使用了"systemPropertiesMode"和/或"systemPropertiesModeName"属性。鼓励用户不再使用这些设置，而是通过容器的Environment配置属性源搜索顺序；然而，可以通过继续使用PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer来保持功能的精确保留。

items.source: the spring-context module is not available (i.e., one is using Spring's BeanFactory API as opposed to ApplicationContext).
items.translation: `spring-context` 模块不可用（即，使用的是 Spring 的 `BeanFactory` API 而非 `ApplicationContext`）。

items.source: placeholder - the placeholder to resolve
items.translation: placeholder - 要解析的占位符

items.source: props - the merged properties of this configurer
items.translation: props - 此配置器的合并属性

items.source: systemPropertiesMode - the system properties mode, according to the constants in this class
items.translation: systemPropertiesMode - 系统属性模式，根据本类中的常量确定。

items.source: key - the placeholder to resolve as system property key
items.translation: key - 作为系统属性键占位符进行解析

items.source: the system property value, or null if not found
items.translation: 系统属性值，如果未找到则为null

items.source: beanFactoryToProcess - the BeanFactory used by the application context
items.translation: beanFactoryToProcess - 由应用程序上下文使用的 BeanFactory

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen

items.source: the resolved value, of null if none
items.translation: 解析后的值，若无则为 null

items.source: as of 5.2, to be removed in 8.0; use org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer instead which is more flexible through taking advantage of the Environment and PropertySource mechanisms.
items.translation: 自 5.2 版本起，将在 8.0 版本中移除；请使用 org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer 替代，它通过利用Environment和PropertySource机制而更加灵活。

items.source: Check system properties if not resolvable in the specified properties.
items.translation: 如果无法在指定的属性中解析，请检查系统属性。

items.source: Check system properties first, before trying the specified properties.
items.translation: 首先检查系统属性，然后再尝试指定的属性。

items.source: Resolve the given placeholder using the given properties.
items.translation: 使用给定属性解析给定的占位符。

items.source:
Resolve the given placeholder using the given properties, performing
a system properties check according to the given mode.
items.translation: 使用给定属性解析给定的占位符，并根据给定模式执行系统属性检查。

items.source:
Set whether to search for a matching system environment variable
if no matching system property has been found.
items.translation: 设置是否在未找到匹配的系统属性时，搜索匹配的系统环境变量。

items.source: Set how to check system properties: as fallback, as override, or never.
items.translation: 设置如何检查系统属性：作为后备、作为覆盖，或从不。

items.source: processProperties in class PropertyResourceConfigurer
items.translation: `processProperties` 类中的 `PropertyResourceConfigurer`

items.source: BeansException - in case of errors
items.translation: BeansException - 在发生错误时

items.source: constantName - name of the constant
items.translation: constantName - 常量的名称

items.source: the resolved value, of null if none
items.translation: 解析后的值，若无则为null。

items.translation: props - 要应用的属性
